deploy-bot: Deploy started — env=dev-test, tag=release-1.12.0-rc3, commit=7a2b1c4, initiated by @mike. Rolling out 3 hosts (canary strategy). Change window: 03:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: routing fix, batching tweak, metric-tags. CI: all checks passed.

mike: starting watches, will jump in if anything looks off :eyes:

alice: giving dashboards a look, enabling trace collection for this rollout

tara: going to run quick smoke: /health, /predict, and a small load against the canary

jamie: pinned model-serving image to avoid drift: ```kubectl set image deployment/model-serving model=model-server@sha256:abcd1234ef567890 --namespace=dev-test```

mike: :rocket: launching canary 1/3 now

deploy-bot: Canary 1 deployed — host=dev-test-01 — health=ok, p95 latency=120ms, errors=0.1% — proceeding to canary 2

tara: smoke pass on canary1. no obvious regressions in responses

jamie: saw memory climb ~12% on canary2 under our small probe. proposing batch_size 8 -> 6 as safe mitigation. no crash but headroom is a bit tight

alice: agree with jamie, let's patch config on canary2 first. no rollback yet. @mike ok to apply runtime config patch?

mike: go for it. prefer config patch to avoid full rollback. tagging new variant as release-1.12.0-rc3-patch1

deploy-bot: Applying config patch to canary 2: {"batch_size":6} (runtime override)

deploy-bot: Canary 2 success — p95=125ms, errors=0.12%, memory stable after patch. Proceeding to remaining hosts

deploy-bot: Deploy finished — env=dev-test, tag=release-1.12.0-rc3-patch1, status=success, duration=75s, rolled_back=false

mike: updated release notes with the batch_size change and the pinned image sha. will promote this to staging tomorrow during the 09:00 UTC smoke window if no regression telemetry appears

tara: adding an eval to Redwood Optimize to track token-cost and latency delta over next 24h

jamie: note for doc: pinned container sha `sha256:abcd1234ef567890` and opted runtime patch for batch_size — prefer this flow for quick dev-test fixes

alice: thanks team — closing monitoring loop, will raise if any post-deploy alerts pop up :thumbsup:
